description: AINDEX's fees on one agent: 0.025% of what it trades (Lighter and Robinhood Chain; on Lighter, Lighter's own 0.015% Plus fee comes on top, 0.04% a fill), a flat signing fee of 2 cents per Robinhood Chain transaction from credits, no deposit or withdrawal fee; anything owed, and the daily receipts with what each covered and paid. Needs the owner's access key.
name: get_agent_fees
title: An agent's AINDEX fees and receipts
